review: Full PNG and 512px JPEG inspected. Warm rough cave rock, cracks, roots, light and square framing remain. Pepe retains wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes; each of the two inherited hands has four fingers and one thumb. No hands were added. The new mark uses ochre stones, a chalk thread and charcoal edges, without text, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, frames or forbidden symbols. Local visual review is not independent artistic certification.
